crossRefs.note: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.
But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought…
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…

translations.web: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
translations.asv: Yet ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah your God:
